name: Omneky
summary: AI ad platform that generates image and video ads, including avatar and clone videos, launches them to Meta, Google, TikTok and other channels, and reports performance per creative.
best_for: e-commerce brands and performance marketers who want AI-generated image and video ads launched and measured across Meta, Google, TikTok and other channels from one place
skip_if: you manage more than five brands without an enterprise contract, or you only need simple static banners
honest_knock: Lite is one brand, one seat and 200 credits, and the video formats most teams want (commercials, avatars, clone video) start on Standard at $99 a month. Credit costs per format are published, but the fee Omneky adds when you launch on its own Meta, Google or OpenAI Ads account is not on the homepage. We have not used Omneky ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-24 on the pricing section of omneky.com, USD, monthly and yearly prices) Lite is $29 a month billed monthly or $24 a month billed yearly, with 200 credits a month, 1 brand and 1 seat; it includes image ads in 12 ratios, short cinematic videos, the Agent and Automations, and Insights with Drilldown View. Standard is $99 a month or $79 a month billed yearly, with 1,000 credits, 3 brands and 3 seats, and adds commercials and professional video, UGC avatars (talking or with your product), clone video and clone image, and long-form avatar video. Pro is $249 a month or $199 a month billed yearly, with 4,000 credits, 5 brands and 5 seats: everything in Standard with four times its monthly credits. Enterprise is priced by sales and adds custom limits, committed pricing, a dedicated success manager, training, creative services, media buying and AI trained on your first-party data. Lite, Standard and Pro start with a 7-day free trial, and the paid plan starts when it ends. The page says yearly billing saves up to 20%; worked out, Lite's yearly rate is about 17% below its monthly price and Standard's and Pro's about 20%. Credit costs: 1K image ad 5, 4K image ad 10, avatar video with a product 20, short commercial up to 15 seconds 30, clone video 5 a second, connecting an ad account free. Top-ups never expire and are spent only after the monthly credits run out; the page gives no top-up price.
